title: Subscribe with a valid test-domain email succeeds
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page (dev environment); footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form (Gravity Forms #5)
expected_result: Form submits successfully and a confirmation/success message is displayed to the user; no error is shown.

title: Submitting the newsletter form with an empty email is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form is not submitted; a validation error indicating the email field is required is displayed.

title: Submitting an email missing the "@" symbol is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form is not submitted; a validation error indicating an invalid email format is displayed.

title: Submitting an email missing the domain part is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form is not submitted; a validation error indicating an invalid email format is displayed.

title: Submitting an email containing spaces is rejected
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
Enter "qa test@example.com" into the email field
expected_result: Form is not submitted; a validation error indicating an invalid email format is displayed.

title: Submitting an email with a trailing dot is handled correctly
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
Enter "qa-test-006@example.com." (note trailing dot) into the email field
expected_result: Form either rejects the value with a validation error, or normalizes/accepts it consistently — behavior must not silently fail or throw an unhandled error. Record actual behavior observed.

title: Submitting a very long email string is handled without error
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible; field has no visible maxLength attribute
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
Enter a 300+ character email string into the email field
expected_result: Form either accepts and submits successfully or rejects with a clear validation error; no page crash, no unhandled JS error, no server 500.

title: Submitting an email with special/unicode characters is handled correctly
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
expected_result: Form either accepts the value as valid or rejects it with a clear validation error; behavior must be consistent and not throw an unhandled error.

title: Rapid repeated submissions of the newsletter form do not create duplicate/erroneous requests
preconditions: Anonymous user on the main page; footer visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup form
Click submit multiple times in rapid succession (e.g. 5 clicks within 1 second)
expected_result: Only one submission is processed (button disables/debounces after first click, or duplicate clicks are ignored); no duplicate confirmation messages and no client-side error.
